title: Rs 99 tickets lift Ramayana 35% on fourth Tuesday as it nears Rs 1,000 crore net
dek: Trackers estimate the film took about Rs 16 crore net in India on day 20. The makers have not released official figures.
author: Declaration Desk
body:
Ramayana: Part One collected an estimated Rs 15.98 crore net in India on Tuesday, its 20th day in cinemas, about 35% more than on Monday, as its makers offered tickets from Rs 99 for the day, according to box-office tracker estimates published on Wednesday. The film's makers have not released official figures since its opening day.

The offer, announced on the film's official social media account, applied only to Tuesday. Monday's takings were about Rs 11.83 crore, the tracker estimated. The Hindi version earned about Rs 13.31 crore of Tuesday's total, more than four-fifths, with the Malayalam, Kannada, Tamil and Telugu versions sharing the rest.

A second tracker's running estimate put the film's India net collection at about Rs 969.50 crore after 20 days, about Rs 30 crore short of Rs 1,000 crore, with an India gross of about Rs 1,158 crore and a worldwide gross of more than Rs 1,723 crore, according to reports. That tracker's Tuesday figure was a provisional Rs 14.05 crore, lower than the first tracker's estimate, and its final number may change.

On those estimates, the film would cross Rs 1,000 crore net in India within days if its weekday takings hold. Nitesh Tiwari's film opened on 5 November, and its first week ran into the Diwali holidays.

Among other releases, the Japanese film Godzilla Minus Zero earned about Rs 56 lakh on Tuesday, taking it to about Rs 4 crore in five days, the first tracker estimated.
